snippet.title: Neural Parasite - Experience a survival horror game where every action is controlled by your mouse!
snippet.description:
Download for free on itch.io https://softbushware.itch.io/neural-parasite?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt After being captured by Nazis in an ambush you are taken to a top secret research bunker. You wake up after being experimented on, everyone is gone and your prison cell door stands wide open. Escape while you have the chance, but be careful, something has gone terribly wrong.

Experience an experimental survival horror game where every action is controlled by your mouse.
